prompts.atlas:
Prepare an animation-parts SPRITE ATLAS from the attached APPROVED original character sheet. Preserve the exact approved identities, facial proportions, flowing hair, colors, hoodie/sweater, trousers and shoes. This is a technical cutout asset, not a redesign. Clean polished 2D illustration identical to the input, with true transparent background everywhere outside the pieces. No text, no labels, no frames, no shadows on a floor, no backgrounds.

Landscape atlas 1536x1024. EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight isolated parts, one centered in each 384x512 cell. Leave ample transparent space between parts and within cell boundaries. Every individual part must remain completely inside its own cell. Do not add extra parts or repeat complete figures.

TOP ROW, Mira, from LEFT to RIGHT:
CELL 1: Mira's HEADLESS BODY from the base of the neck through both cream shoes. Mustard short hoodie, plum wide cropped trousers. Keep her hanging arm/hand on the viewer's RIGHT, but REMOVE the cup-holding arm on the viewer's LEFT completely. Reconstruct the uninterrupted torso fabric behind the removed arm. Keep a little natural neck stump at the collar. No head or hair attached. Keep the approved relaxed standing weight shift.
CELL 2: Mira's isolated complete HEAD AND SHORT NECK, including all flowing plum hair, ears, full pink face. The approved friendly interested expression in a gentle right-facing three-quarter view. No shoulders or clothing.
CELL 3: EXACT SAME Mira head, hair, neck, orientation and size as cell 2, but with a gently uncertain/worried expression: brows raised toward center, small downturned mouth. Same silhouette and registration as cell 2. No shoulders or clothing.
CELL 4: Mira's isolated CUP-HOLDING ARM, from the rounded natural hoodie shoulder through the bent elbow and pink gripping hand and cream cup. Exact approved sleeve, pale cuff if visible, curved fingers around cup, visible thumb. Retain the ORIGINAL bent pose, shoulder upper-left, elbow lower-left, hand and cup extending up and to the right. No torso.

BOTTOM ROW, Sol, from LEFT to RIGHT:
CELL 5: Sol's HEADLESS BODY from neck base through coral shoes. Deep teal rolled-sleeve round-neck sweater and roomy lavender trousers. Keep the viewer's RIGHT arm with the hand in the trouser pocket, but REMOVE the conversational arm on the viewer's LEFT. Reconstruct the torso under that arm. Little neck stump, no head/hair.
CELL 6: Sol's isolated complete HEAD AND SHORT NECK, including all indigo swept hair and ears, warm ochre/orange face and attentive small smile, in the APPROVED left-facing THREE-QUARTER view of the full-body figure. No shoulders or clothing.
CELL 7: EXACT SAME Sol head, hair, neck, orientation and size as cell 6, but a natural CLOSED-EYE BLINK, two small soft curved eyelid lines instead of the two dark eyes. Everything else unchanged. No shoulders or clothing.
CELL 8: Sol's isolated CONVERSATIONAL ARM, complete from sweater shoulder through bent elbow, rolled cuff and relaxed open palm, exactly like the approved figure: palm to the LEFT, upper arm/shoulder to the RIGHT. Clear thumb and gently grouped curved fingers, never spiky. No torso.

Preserve the approved illustration style and character anatomy. The two bodies should be drawn as large as comfortably possible in their cells. Heads should be large and detailed in their own cells and match their counterpart head exactly. Keep all eight parts isolated in their assigned cells, no overlaps, no cropping, real alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted into the image.
prompts.blinks:
Edit the attached transparent 4-column, 2-row animation sprite atlas, preserving its exact canvas size, grid, positions, silhouettes, colors, and all character identities. Maintain true alpha transparency. Make only these localized corrections:
1. In TOP ROW COLUMN 2 and TOP ROW COLUMN 3, replace Mira's two open dark eyes with two natural gently curved CLOSED EYELID lines for a blink. Preserve every other facial feature, each expression, the face shape, full hair, short neck, sizes and positions. These are matching registered blink variants of the open-eye atlas.
2. In TOP ROW COLUMN 4, the detached cup-holding sleeve incorrectly has a cream collar/hood rim at its top. Remove only that cream rim and replace it with matching smooth mustard sleeve fabric, forming a simple rounded shoulder cap of a cloth sleeve. This isolated arm must not contain a hood or neckline. Keep the rest of the arm, bent elbow, hand, cup, scale, and position exactly unchanged.
Everything else, including both headless bodies, both Sol heads, and Sol's arm, must remain identical. No labels, no new pieces, no backgrounds.
prompts.plaza: Create an ORIGINAL high-end 2D illustrated BACKGROUND PLATE for a 20-second animated film, matching the soft flat-shape illustration style and saturated colors of the attached approved character sheet. No people, no characters, no animals, no text, no logos, no signs, no lettering. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, an empty city pedestrian plaza at deep blue-purple twilight, with a small public garden and a cafe facade to the far right. Sophisticated appealing large geometric architecture with rounded corners, layered perspective, distant towers in muted saturated blue, a few warm small windows on side buildings, beautifully drawn stylized foliage framing the far left and far right, broad paving shapes and restrained curved ground shadows. Not a repeated grid of identical windows. Quiet indigo/purple wall and open space behind the center-right of the image where a character will be composited; no bright window or strong lines through the face area. The left upper quadrant should be quiet dark shapes for a story title to be added later. The ground is level across the lower quarter, horizon around 70% down. Rich violet and cobalt palette with a few restrained teal leaves and warm coral/gold accents. Professional cinematic 2D editorial illustration with carefully designed silhouettes, clean confident curved contours and restrained shadow planes, a little soft gradient depth, no painterly brush texture, no 3D, no photorealism. No overlays, no panels. The illustration fills the entire image edge to edge; keep the ground and major shapes safe if top and bottom are cropped slightly to 16:9.
prompts.terrace: Create an ORIGINAL high-end 2D illustrated BACKGROUND PLATE for an animated film, in exactly the soft flat-shape illustration family of the attached approved character sheet. No people, no characters, no animals, no text, no lettering, no logos, no signs. Wide landscape 16:9, an intimate exterior public cafe garden terrace in warm late-afternoon light. A small empty public meeting space, attractive asymmetrical composition, dark cool indigo/purple wall occupying the central 65% of the frame as a quiet backdrop for the faces of two standing characters to be added later. Warm peach side wall and a glimpse of a soft sunset city in the far left quarter. A restrained mint/teal glass cafe doorway at the far right edge, partially framed by an overhead tree canopy with beautifully designed large foliage masses. A low terracotta planter and foliage near the left lower corner, maybe one small empty bench far in the background. NO central bright window, NO central table, NO furniture in the central character staging area, NO repeating floor grid. Broad clean ground plane across the bottom quarter, gentle diagonal sunlight and a few soft cast shadows establish depth. The focus will be the people standing around x40% and x73% with faces in the upper-middle; keep those areas quiet and dark. Warm peach, plum, teal, cream, and restrained gold accents, polished layered architecture and plant contours, confident appealing shape design, crisp 2D edges, subtle gradient shadow planes matching the character art. No 3D, no photorealism, no painterly texture. Full bleed wide landscape, with safe margins for slight top/bottom crop to 16:9.
